params.description: Times range, in UTC and ISO 8601 compliant, delimited by a forward slash. The time range of data has a maximum of 24 hours allowed. This parameter is **optional**, and is mainly used for accessing older, archived data. If not given, returns the latest data available.

info.name: Geocoder
Returns geographic coordinates of the provided search text.

params.name: searchText
params.description: The location or place you are trying to look up. This could be an address, a point of interest name, a city name, etc.

params.name: willPersist
params.description: Specify whether to request persistent geocodes (`true`) or not (`false`, default). When persist is enabled, you are contractually allowed to temporarily cache or permanently store the response, and the backing geocoder service will charge these types of requests at a higher rate.

params.name: autocomplete
params.description: Specify whether to return autocomplete results (`true`) or not (`false`, default). When autocomplete is enabled, results will be included that start with the requested string, rather than just responses that match it exactly.

params.name: limit
params.description: Specify the maximum number of results to return. The default is `5` and the maximum supported is `10`. This parameter is only relevant if the autocomplete feature is enabled. When autocomplete is disabled, the API will return a single result.

params.name: country
params.description: Limit results to one or more countries. Permitted values are ISO 3166 alpha 2 country codes separated by commas. When bbox and country filters are both enabled, the request will utilize only the initial parameter specified.

params.name: bbox
params.description: Limit results to only those contained within the supplied bounding box. Bounding boxes should be supplied as four numbers separated by commas, in minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat order. When bbox and country filters are both enabled, the request will utilize only the initial parameter specified.

params.name: proximity
params.description: Bias the response to favor results that are closer to this location. Provided as two comma-separated coordinates in `longitude,latitude` order.

params.name: placeTypes
params.description: Filter results to include only a subset (one or more) of the available feature types. Options are `country`, `region`, `postcode`, `district`, `place`, `locality`, `neighborhood`, `address`. Multiple options can be comma-separated.

params.name: locale
params.description:
Specifies the desired language and country code for language translation and formatting conventions.
Supported languages are English (en) and Spanish (es). However, any 2-letter ISO country code is supported as locale. See [here](https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search/code) for a list of country codes.
Defaults to English (en-US) if unsupported locale is specified.
If provided, overrides the Accept-Language header.

info.name: Image
Returns static image with or without basemap

params.name: layerIds
params.description: Comma separated list of layer ids to render in stacking order.

params.name: opacities
params.description: Comma separated list of opacities to apply to each of the requested layers, in the same order as in the layerIds attribute. Layers with no matching opacity will use the default one being used in its style. Valid values from 0 to 1 inclusive.

params.name: smoothingProfiles
params.description: Comma separated list of smoothing profiles to apply to each of the requested layers, in the same order as in the layerIds attribute. Layers with no matching smoothing profile will not be smoothed.

params.name: width
params.description: Width of the rendered image in pixels

params.name: height
params.description: Height of the rendered image in pixels

params.name: time
params.description: Timestamp in UTC and ISO 8601 format. It indicates the time the image should be valid for.

params.name: basemapStyleURL
params.description:
URL for a Mapbox data driven style defining a base map.
When using a custom one, please provide an access token. - Streets: mapbox://styles/dtn-mapbox/ckwv1d32r4vsw14poxf2forep - Dark: mapbox://styles/dtn-mapbox/ckwv21klw3k2v15pi0igs3uk1 - Light: mapbox://styles/dtn-mapbox/ckwv1z6fh5prn14pcdx8xqrja - Outdoors: mapbox://styles/dtn-mapbox/ckwv1rso35jf614mn4mc9fq82 - Satellite: mapbox://styles/dtn-mapbox/ckwv24fqs3k5e15pihmf9qtrc - Navigation-day: mapbox://styles/dtn-mapbox/ckwv2ch170bul14qg6xneqxri - Navigation-night: mapbox://styles/dtn-mapbox/ckwv2jjos05v215pcse1xqjw8 If using EPSG code of 3031 (Antarctic Polar Stereographic), the following styles must be use - 3031 Streets: https://map.api.dtn.com/static/layers/basemaps/3031/styles/street/style.json - 3031 Dark: https://map.api.dtn.com/static/layers/basemaps/3031/styles/dark/style.json - 3031 Light: https://map.api.dtn.com/static/layers/basemaps/3031/styles/light/style.json If using EPSG code of 3995 (Arctic Polar Stereographic), the following styles must be use - 3995 Streets: https://map.api.dtn.com/static/layers/basemaps/3995/styles/street/style.json - 3995 Dark: https://map.api.dtn.com/static/layers/basemaps/3995/styles/dark/style.json - 3995 Light: https://map.api.dtn.com/static/layers/basemaps/3995/styles/light/style.json

params.name: basemapVisibilityOverrides
params.description: Comma separated string of pairs like "layerId:true|false" defining layout visibility overrides for the basemap provided by the basemapStyleURL parameter. Wildcards are allowed in the layerId.

params.name: viewport
params.description:
Defines the area to be rendered using comma separated numbers. Area can be defined either through:
- lon,lat,zoom
lon should be between -180 and 180, lat between -90 and 90, zoom between 0 and 22 - minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat
minLon and maxLon should be between -360 and 360, minLat and maxLat between -90 and 90, zoom between 0 and 22, minLon < maxLon, minLat < maxLat

params.name: dtnLogoPosition
params.description: indicates position for DTN logo

params.name: unit
params.description: Unit system (with or without industry specific overrides) to use when returning data.

params.name: locale
params.description:
Specifies the desired language and country code for language translation and formatting conventions.
Supported languages are English (en) and Spanish (es). However, any 2-letter ISO country code is supported as locale. See [here](https://www.iso.org/obp/ui/#search/code) for a list of country codes.
Defaults to English (en-US) if unsupported locale is specified.
If provided, overrides the Accept-Language header.

params.name: epsg
params.description:
Specifies the projection to be used, as defined by an EPSG code.
The EPSG code being used must be present in the supportedEPSGs metadata attribute for each of the layers requested.
When using a basemap style url, make sure to reference one using the same EPSG. Example values: - 3857 - Web Mercator - 3031 - Antarctic Polar Stereographic - 3995 - Arctic Polar Stereographic
